translationRepairs: His great-grandfather Xi served the Murong as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
His great-great-grandfather Xi served the Murong as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
In the ancestor list, 高祖悕 is Zhang Lie’s paternal great-great-grandfather Xi; ‘great-grandfather’ understates 高祖 by one generation (cf. following 曾祖恂).
His great-grandfather Xi was Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing under the Murong.
His great-great-grandfather Xi was Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing under the Murong.
Same kinship term 高祖 requires great-great-grandfather in the literal; ‘great-grandfather’ is the wrong generation.

In the third year of Xiaochang he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director, and served as mobile headquarters over Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.

In the third year of Xiaochang he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director, and served as mobile headquarters over the two provinces of Qi and Yan directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.
齊兗二州 means the two provinces Qi and Yan; ‘Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces’ misreads 二州 as modifying 兗 alone.
